description: A woman in a dark period dress with a white fichu and bonnet, with a tricolour cockade at her chest, stands on a wooden crate in a narrow stone street. She holds a printed page aloft and shouts toward a crowd of men and women. A torch flares at right and a man in a tricolour-style hat sits in the foreground. The setting and dress suggest late 18th-century Paris. No readable text is legible; the paper shows only indistinct marks. No frame, border, or gore is visible.
